Subject: Post-demo: DPA / SCC orientation and next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for joining the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep the contracting thread moving: 

Call recap (5 mins):
- Medivo confirms interest in Redwood for inference on patient-matching workflows.
- Primary compliance asks: GDPR DPA + SCC selection, SOC 2 evidence, and HIPAA posture confirmation.

Open items / asks from Redwood:
1) Controller vs. Processor: we need confirmation of the roles for the relationship so our legal team can select the appropriate SCC module. From the demo it sounded like Medivo will be the controller and Redwood the processor, but please confirm.
2) SCC preference: if you have a preferred SCC module (e.g., Module 1 vs Module 2) let us know — we can recommend the typical processor flow.
3) SOC 2: we noted you requested our Type II report and attestation window. We'll surface the latest report once legal gives the green light for sharing.
4) VSQ / security questionnaire: attached is our lightweight DPA draft plus an SCC options spreadsheet. If you can send your legal contact or upload your VSQ, that speeds review.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf (DPA draft), scc-options-overview.xlsx (summary of modules).

Proposed next steps:
- Sara / Medivo to confirm controller/processor and preferred SCC module by end of day Wed (3/3).
- Redwood legal (Ben) to prepare redline path assuming Redwood acts as processor and Module 2 is selected.
- Schedule a 30-min legal-to-legal sync if redlines are requested — propose Thu 3/4 or Fri 3/5.

I can own coordination on our side — copying Jordan and Ben to align internal owners.

Thanks,
Irene

Thanks, Irene — great demo and helpful summary. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Role confirmation: Medivo is the data controller for the patient-matching dataset; Redwood will be a processor for the service (that aligns with our expectations).
- SCC module: our legal team typically prefers the processor-focused Module 2, so please proceed with Module 2 as the default.
- SOC 2: we require a current Type II for control coverage in the last 12 months. Please share the report or an interim summary and the SOC auditor contact if possible.
- HIPAA: this project will handle limited PHI elements for matching. We will need assurance around BAAs — can you point us to Redwood's standard BAA language or confirm whether Redwood has a BAA template?

I've looped in our Legal/InfoSec alias (secops@medivo.com). I attached the first-pass VSQ where our team filled high-level answers — it's incomplete but should help jumpstart your review.
